definitions.gloss: Chinese-style noodles; ramen noodles; alkaline wheat noodles
definitions.explanation: Wheat noodles made with kansui (alkaline mineral water), giving them their characteristic yellow color, springy texture, and distinctive flavor. The base noodle used in ramen, yakisoba, and other Chinese-influenced Japanese dishes.

examples.japanese: {中華麺|ちゅうかめん}を{茹|ゆ}でる。
ラーメンには{中華麺|ちゅうかめん}が{使|つか}われる。
examples.english: Chinese-style noodles are used in ramen.

examples.japanese: スーパーで{中華麺|ちゅうかめん}を{買|か}って、{家|いえ}で{焼|や}きそばを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I bought Chinese-style noodles at the supermarket and made yakisoba at home.

notes:
A compound of {中華|ちゅうか} (Chinese cuisine) and {麺|めん} (noodles). These noodles are distinguished from {蕎麦|そば} (buckwheat noodles) and うどん (thick wheat noodles) by the use of {鹹水|かんすい} (kansui, alkaline water), which gives them a yellow tint and chewy texture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中華麺|ちゅうかめん}を{茹|ゆ}でる: to boil Chinese noodles
- {生|なま}{中華麺|ちゅうかめん}: fresh Chinese noodles
- {乾燥|かんそう}{中華麺|ちゅうかめん}: dried Chinese noodles
- {太|ふと}{麺|めん}/{細|ほそ}{麺|めん}: thick noodles / thin noodles

RELATED WORDS:
- ラーメン: ramen — the most common dish made with {中華麺|ちゅうかめん}
- {焼|や}きそば: fried noodles — another popular dish using these noodles
- うどん: udon — thick wheat noodles without kansui
- {蕎麦|そば}: soba — buckwheat noodles
